## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky34

### Fork PRs

| PR | Change | Measured JVM allocation saved / baseline |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [#62](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/62) | Serialize option cache keys directly | 34.4 GB / 833.5 GB (4.13%) |
| [#63](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/63) | Reduce long-string fingerprint allocations | 16.5 GB / 831.4 GB (1.98%) |
| [#64](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/64) | Reuse immutable option metadata | 6.5 GB / 831.4 GB (0.78%) |
| [#65](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/65) | Skip parsing empty module registrations | 16.7 GB / 831.7 GB (2.01%) |
| [#66](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/66) | Avoid allocations when hashing module versions | 1.8 GB / 831.7 GB (0.21%) |

These are independently measured means from two partial-analysis runs per variant on Bazel 9.3. They measure allocated bytes, not retained heap or peak RSS, and must not be added together. The fingerprint change may allocate more for some UTF-16 strings; the module-version reduction is small relative to run-to-run variation.

### Additional upstream backports

- Cache hashes in `PlatformValue.Key`, `ConstraintCollection`, `PlatformProperties`, and `AspectParameters` (`c81d8ebcae`, `102a75642c`).
- Cache immutable private-API allowlist conversions by identity and avoid repeated repository-mapping checks (`75ec83caca`). Preserve all existing release allowlist entries.
- Avoid boxing download timestamps in `UiStateTracker` and precompute `Attribute` public names (`999a56710d`, `0116c358cc`).
- Intern `SpawnLimits`, lazily allocate spawn retry maps, and avoid stream allocations when summing retries (`891da42d7d`, `01b9863432`).
- Avoid boxed directory-sort indices, temporary `Dirent` objects, and `Pair<Path, Symlinks>` syscall-cache keys (`13addfa86d`, `8b3ba94bf1`, `77d2b68be5`).
- Reuse Zstd buffers for shared-value and file-dependency serialization (`b9095bd7a2`, `4bf9dc097f`, `9bfadce147`).
- Reuse existing action input sets for Java compilation and actions without cached inputs (`814de84b19`, `e7887b10cf`).
- Intern critical-path runner details and release completed phase metrics (`74e2213b18`, `7c45204a8c`).
- Release BEP event graphs after stream closure (`095491a7b9`).
- Reuse per-thread task counters in `AbstractQueueVisitor` (`8f26fe3402`).

Include the associated correctness fixes: decrement task counts only once during interruption (`174b1d940e`) and preserve parent-before-child BEP transport delivery (`b7284e2990`).

### Validation

Twenty-six of twenty-seven targeted release test targets passed uncached on Linux remote execution, including options, fingerprints, platform hashes, toolchain registration, transitions, filesystem caches, metrics, BEP, concurrency, serialization, generated queries, and Starlark/C++/Java analysis. `BazelSkycacheIntegrationTest` retains its previously documented count-assertion failure (8 configured targets versus a minimum of 9); its other 42 cases passed. The assertion is unchanged. All ten targeted test targets for the five upstream PRs and all 21 immutable-release publication checks passed.

Linux and macOS prebuilts for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before immutable publication, with SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance records. Existing release tags and assets are preserved.
